name: reposilite
description: Reposilite is a lightweight Maven repository manager for hosting release, snapshot, and private artifacts. It provides a web dashboard, access tokens, and proxy repositories.

notes.text: The initial manager token defaults to admin. Its name and random secret are stored in /etc/conf.d/reposilite inside the container.
Create a persistent manager token with token-generate administrator m in the dashboard console, then clear bootstrap_secret in /etc/conf.d/reposilite and restart Reposilite.
The dashboard uses HTTP (default port 8080). Configure HTTPS with your reverse proxy before exposing it outside a trusted network.

app_vars.name: var_data_dir
app_vars.label: Data directory
app_vars.help: Absolute path below /var/lib or /srv; holds SQLite, repositories and local configuration.

app_vars.name: var_public_repositories
app_vars.label: Public repository names
app_vars.help: Comma-separated unique IDs; use - for none.

app_vars.name: var_private_repositories
app_vars.label: Private repository names
app_vars.help: Comma-separated unique IDs; use - for none.

app_vars.name: var_repository_quota
app_vars.label: Quota per repository (%)
app_vars.help: 1-100 percent of available storage, applied separately to each repository; does not reserve disk space.

app_vars.name: var_dashboard_description
app_vars.label: Dashboard description
app_vars.default: Public Maven repository hosted through Reposilite

app_vars.name: var_repositories_json
app_vars.label: Advanced repository definitions (JSON)
app_vars.help: Optional Reposilite repositories array. Overrides repository names, quotas and switches. Requires unique IDs, visibility and fs storageProvider; accepts per-repository mount/proxied settings.
